definitions.explanation: A shop that sells souvenirs, local specialties, and gifts, typically found at tourist destinations, train stations, and airports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Souvenir shops line the area in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought souvenirs for my friends at a gift shop in the tourist area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名産品|めいさんひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧にぎわって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This souvenir shop has a wide selection of local specialties and is always bustling with tourists.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{土産物|みやげもの}→土産物：23122_miyagemono⟧ (souvenir goods) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/seller). Typically found at ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧ (tourist spots), ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ (stations), and ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧ (airports).

FORMS:
- {土産物屋|みやげものや}: souvenir shop (standard)
- お⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧さん: souvenir shop (casual, polite)
- ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: souvenir store (slightly formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a souvenir shop
- {土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: souvenir shops lined up
- {土産物屋|みやげものや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覗|のぞ}く→覗く：02388_nozoku⟧: to browse a souvenir shop

CULTURAL NOTE:
Buying ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧ (souvenirs) for family, friends, and coworkers is an important social custom in Japan. {土産物屋|みやげものや} at popular tourist destinations typically sell {名産品|めいさんひん} (local specialties) and {銘菓|めいか} (famous confections).
